name: Wolf (Ze'ev) Armoured Vehicle
armament: Optional remote weapon station on the roof (7.62 mm or 12.7 mm MG)
protection: About 3 t of armour around the crew box, drivetrain and wheels; armoured doors and run-flat tyres; protected against rifle fire and fragments. Game: immune to small calibre; 7.62x54R and larger can penetrate (side/rear), launchers kill it.
visual_notes: Commercial Ford F-550 truck chassis with a separate boxy armoured body: long flat-sided crew box, sloped front bonnet armour
2 axles, single rear wheels per side on a heavy truck chassis, large wheel arches
Six doors: two crew doors, two side doors and two rear doors; small thick bullet-proof windows in rows
Roof hatches and optional RWS; grille guard and lights cage at the front; often a riot-screen frame or mesh on windows
IDF sand/olive paint with black hatch details; Border Police versions grey-green
